result.title: GraftRay: Physically Based Mesh Insertion into Gaussian Splatting Scenes via Path Tracing
result.summary: Inserting virtual objects into scenes reconstructed via 2D or 3D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS/3DGS) is a key capability for content creation, AR, and synthetic data generation. However, realistic insertion requires the object to be seamlessly lit by the scene and, conversely, to cast physically plausible shadows onto it. Existing approaches either harmonize appearance in image space, sacrificing multi-view consistency, or approximate scene illumination with an environment map at the insertion point, which cannot represent near-field area lights such as windows and lamps that dominate indoor lighting. To address this, we present GraftRay, a unified method for physically consistent insertion of mesh objects into indoor scenes represented by either 2D or 3D Gaussians. We recover scene materials and surface normals with diffusion-based priors, and explicitly model spatially-extended emitters, solving their radiance in closed form. A hybrid renderer then jointly path-traces the scene Gaussians and inserted meshes, producing view-consistent shading, interreflections, and soft shadows. On FIPT, GraftRay sets a new state of the art, outperforming recent baselines such as ComGS and EAG-PT in rendering fidelity and shadow accuracy, while maintaining highly competitive rendering efficiency.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 GraftRay，在用 2DGS/3DGS 重建的室内场景中物理一致地插入网格物体：借助扩散先验恢复材质与法线、显式建模空间扩展光源，并用混合渲染器对高斯场景与插入网格联合路径追踪，以获得多视角一致的着色与软阴影。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作聚焦三维高斯场景的材质恢复与路径追踪渲染保真度，不涉及 VLM 推理、latent 状态生成或证据与停止决策，也未见可供迁移的推理期表示或训练监督线索。
